story: i made room for you when the other tables filled up. blue backpack, white t-shirt. you smiled when we both closed our notebooks at once. that would've been a good time to say hi

title: Man in the navy sweater
story: you were explaining why you'd changed subjects while we walked toward the exit, navy sweater, light brown curls. my turn came sooner than i wanted it to

title: comparing the lecture notes
story: You recognized my class notes and asked if you could see the page you'd missed, green folder, red sweatshirt. We compared lectures while waiting. i wish i'd asked your name
question: Which class were the notes from?

title: wrong table, right smile
story: you put your coffee down in front of me, then realized your friend was at the next table. red sweater, black curls. we laughed. i would've been happy if youd stayed

title: outside class at Georgetown
story: we passed outside class while you were with your friends you looked back as i turned around. brown jacket, dark curls. if you noticed the girl in green, that was me

title: hello instead of sorry?
story: We both stepped aside to let the other through. Dark curls, brown hoodie i recognize you from here, but we only managed sorry and a smile. Can we try hello next time?

title: you brought the cable back
story: you borrowed my phone cable before class and came back to return it. brown sweater, round glasses. i was busy when you came over, but id have liked to talk more

title: your friend's story got me too
story: your friend said something that made me laugh too you looked over and grinned. green coat, black bob. would love to be part of the conversation next time

title: your coffee, my notebook
story: You left your drink beside my notebook while you took your coat off, i asked if you meant to sit there. Gray shirt, brown hair. You laughed and went back to your friend

title: we caught each other's eye
story: i noticed you while i was out with a friend. striped shirt, black hair, camera in your hand you smiled when we looked at each other. i would've liked to ask about your photos

title: same class last semester?
story: we passed each other outside and you gave me a nod, navy jacket, short beard. i think we shared a class last semester. would love to find out if i'm right

title: Woman with the blue scarf
story: You looked up from your book as i went by and smiled. Blue scarf, short black hair i didnt want to disturb you, but would enjoy talking during a reading break

title: Girl in the striped shirt
story: you let me have the copy we'd both been looking at. i've finished the chapter i needed. striped shirt, black curls. would love to return the favor and see you again
question: Which book were we looking for?

title: back at La Colombe
story: You looked familiar, then smiled like you recognized me too. Gray shirt, green backpack i didnt ask whether we'd met before. if you remember the woman with the blue mug, hi

title: next time, no phone call
story: we keep ending up near each other here burgundy backpack, shaved head. you said a quick hello this time, but i was taking a call. would love to talk without my phone interrupting

title: waiting at Coffee Mind
story: You were waiting with a friend and seemed about to speak when i came past. Gray T-shirt, brown hair i was in a hurry then. Could we try again?

title: almost collided at the door
story: i nearly walked into the door you were opening. we both apologized and laughed short hair, navy sweater. i was distracted then, but i remember you very clearly now

title: Guy in the gray T-shirt
story: We walked a few steps together while i pointed out the turn. Gray T-shirt, blue backpack you thanked me and went on. wanted to come up with one more thing to say

title: Woman in the striped sweater
story: You asked whether i was waiting for someone. Before i answered properly, your friend called you over blonde hair, striped sweater. For the record, i wasnt

title: your joke made me laugh
story: i couldnt help laughing at what you said at the counter. you turned around and smiled at me. striped shirt, red hair. i nearly followed up outside but lost my nerve

title: thanks for the little smiley
story: you left my pen on my notebook with a small smiley beside your thanks. blonde hair, navy cardigan i looked up to say something but you were already at the door

title: Red sweatshirt
story: you apologized for taking my page with yours, no problem at all. red sweatshirt, short beard. i was the woman who asked if you were also having trouble with the printer

title: Guy in black
story: You had your headphones on and didnt hear me at first, i brought your gym bag over. Black T-shirt, close-cropped hair. You took the headphones off and gave me the nicest smile

title: same class, different printouts
story: you noticed we were printing notes for the same class. we talked about the upcoming assignment. red glasses, brown cardigan. i left before asking which session you attended
question: Which class were the notes from?

title: Man with the blue scarf
story: You looked over while putting your things away and smiled. Blue scarf, round glasses. I was alone too. I wish I'd asked if you had time for another drink.
